faqs.q: How do I place an order?
faqs.a: Browse restaurants or search for a dish, add items to your cart, then tap Place order. Choose a payment method and confirm.

faqs.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
faqs.a: You can cancel an ongoing order from My Orders > Ongoing > Cancel. Once the restaurant starts preparing it, cancellation may not be possible.

faqs.q: How long will my delivery take?
faqs.a: Each restaurant shows an estimated delivery time. Busy hours and bad weather can add a few minutes.

faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: You can pay with cash on delivery, or with a saved Visa or Mastercard. More methods are coming soon.

faqs.q: How do I add or change my delivery address?
faqs.a: Go to Profile > Addresses. You can add, edit or delete addresses and label them Home, Work or Other.
Many restaurants offer free delivery. Others show a small fee on their card, which is added to your total at checkout.

faqs.q: How do I use a coupon code?
faqs.a: Offers appear on the home screen when available. Copy the code shown in the offer and apply it at checkout.

faqs.q: I have a problem with my order. What now?
faqs.a: Contact support using the button below and include your order number. We'll get back to you as soon as we can.

sections.heading: 1. Using the app
sections.body: By creating an account you agree to use the app lawfully and to provide accurate information when ordering.

sections.heading: 2. Orders and payments
sections.body: Prices and delivery times are set by each restaurant. Your payment method is charged when you confirm an order.

sections.heading: 3. Cancellations
sections.body: Orders can be cancelled before the restaurant starts preparing them. Refunds, where due, return to the original payment method.

sections.heading: 4. Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the app means you accept the updated terms.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect your name, email, delivery addresses and order history so we can deliver your food.

sections.heading: Location
sections.body: Location access is optional and only used while the app is open to suggest nearby restaurants.

sections.heading: Payments
sections.body: We store only the last four digits of your card. Full card numbers and security codes are never saved.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: You can edit your details, manage notifications or delete your account at any time from Settings.
